name: Red Bird Center
summary: Red Bird Center is a community shopping center serving southwest Dallas along Camp Wisdom Road. This neighborhood retail destination provides convenient access to everyday shopping and services for the diverse Red Bird community.
demographics: Red Bird Center serves a diverse, predominantly middle-income community in southwest Dallas, with a significant Hispanic and African American population. The trade area attracts families and working-class households seeking convenient, value-oriented shopping options. Primary shoppers include residents within a 3-5 mile radius who prioritize accessibility and everyday necessities over luxury retail experiences.
description: Red Bird Center is a community shopping destination located at 4210 West Camp Wisdom Road in the Red Bird neighborhood of southwest Dallas, Texas. Established as a retail hub serving the diverse communities of southern Dallas, this center has been a fixture in the area for decades, providing essential shopping and services to local residents. The property offers convenient access along Camp Wisdom Road, one of the area's main thoroughfares, making it easily accessible for the surrounding neighborhoods. With a 4.2-star rating from over 100 reviews, Red Bird Center continues to serve as a practical shopping option for families and residents seeking everyday retail needs. The center's open-air format and community-focused tenant mix reflect its role as a neighborhood gathering place in this established Dallas community.
